name: P.I.E. Industrial Berhad
overview: 2026年公司公告主要为季度业绩、股息派发、股东常年大会及关联交易授权续期等常规事项，未见有关业务板块扩张、新增业务、缩减或出售、或获得合约的公告。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比减少22.0%，净利润同比减少40.2%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company's announcements were mainly routine matters such as quarterly results, dividend payment, annual general meeting and renewal of shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions. No announcements were made regarding business segment expansion, new businesses, downsizing or disposal, or contract wins. In the latest quarter (30 June 2026), revenue decreased by 22.0% year-on-year and net profit decreased by 40.2% year-on-year.
